Package com.datastax.driver.core

Class TabletMap.Tablet

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.datastax.driver.core.TabletMap.Tablet
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Comparable<TabletMap.Tablet>
    Enclosing class:
    TabletMap
    public static class TabletMap.Tablet
extends Object
implements Comparable<TabletMap.Tablet>
    Represents a single tablet created from tablets-routing-v1 custom payload. Its compareTo implementation intentionally relies solely on lastToken in order to allow for quick lookup on sorted Collections based just on the token value.
